role: Development optimization comparison on the fixed reversible component. Separate acquisition, decoded composition competence and cost; no foundation, novelty, language, continual adaptation or practical speed claim.

data.scope: Fresh signed-permutation/flip world. All fitting initial and prefix states are in the training state partition. Validation/development paths may also visit training states but cannot enter another held-out state partition. Complement-paired sampling balances canonical bits. Neither runtime nor fitting sees canonical state, inverse observation map or action rules.

model.architecture: Unchanged EXP-0008 reversible model: four generic alternating even/odd additive coupling layers, each 5->30 tanh->5; inverse decoder and four affine action maps.
model.initialization: Both arms start from identical own-seed model parameters. No oracle or prior learned snapshots. The refit arm replaces the initial maps using observed training pairs before step-zero measurement; this charged solve is part of the intervention.

training.curriculum: Own initialization for one-step fits. Complete both rates and all seeds per arm, selecting lr003 before lr010 only if every seed passes. Each selected one-step snapshot may initialize its own mixed fit with fresh Adam. No tiny gate, prior successful seed or cross-arm warm start.
training.sampling: Identical seeded uniform stage-training trajectories; group by length, uniform length choice in mixed fitting. Seed offset +1 for one and +2 for mixed.
training.prediction_loss: Mean squared observed-coordinate error over every free-running prefix, averaged within and across trajectories.
training.joint: Update all 1780 model parameters with Adam.
training.refit: Adam updates only 1340 coupling parameters. Fit action maps at step zero and every 32 updates including final, before measuring. Treat each solve as detached; no implicit derivative through least squares and no added latent training objective. Between solves, prediction gradients flow through fixed affine maps to the encoder and inverse decoder.
training.auxiliary: Same observed reconstruction term and targets in both arms; reconstruction is numerically near zero by construction. Fitting encoded target observations is disclosed additional computation over the same permitted one-step pool.

acquisition.selection: Minimum validation prediction MSE among checkpoints passing every gate; earliest step breaks ties. If none passes retain minimum loss and failure. Complete the registered duration.
acquisition.mixed_admission: Complete both one-step rates before selecting the first common rate with every seed acquired. Every selected parent needs full replay. Mixed fitting is per seed from its own selected one-step parameters.

evaluation.scope: One-step and familiar short acquisition first. Development compositions and continuation are admitted for an arm only if every mixed seed at its selected common rate passes and all selected mixed parents fully replay. Final trajectories have no entry point.
evaluation.families: The existing 608-case development set, all intermediate prefixes, and 64 common-state continuation pairs. Own predicted states only. Preserve zero-initial, reversed-order and zero-state controls; label true-current-observation resets explicitly.
evaluation.comparison: Fixed mapping architecture, data, seeds, batches, prediction objective and gradient-update ceilings. Refit has extra full-pool encoding/solving and fewer gradient-trained parameters; report actual compute and example exposures. It does not receive new underlying observations. A failed joint arm is not a competent practical-advantage comparator.
evaluation.decision: Reliable acquisition requires every seed at one common rate to pass both one and mixed gates. Report paired common-rate differences separately from differently selected conditions. Conditional development can establish scoped candidate competence only when every seed passes the registered total/family/continuation floors; no significance or practical advantage claim without competent controls and matched total cost.
evaluation.follow_on: Close this comparison at declared limits. Only then select any separate confirmation or representation-bridge experiment that retains learned operations; do not tune on final data.

verification: Committed source/protocol; rank/orientation independent mathematical fixtures; frozen transition gradients and coupling invariance during refit; scalar/tensor prediction and own-state persistence; actual-input audit; synthetic post-fit failure; complete checkpoint/selection/refit/evaluation replay; private backup and restored-source replay. Parameters support inference, not exact optimizer resume.
stop_condition: Close after two rates and three seeds per optimizer, at most one selected mixed condition and one development evaluation per acquired seed. Preserve every failed run. No model-size increase, solver fallback, latent-only success, final access, provider redesign or unregistered retry.

solver.fit: For each action, encode initial and observed next vectors with the current learned encoder in float32, convert to float64, append a bias column, and solve X B approximately Y. Require rank 11, finite solution and condition <=1e8. Copy B[:10].T and B[10] to float32 transition tensors only after all four solves pass.
solver.support: Use the fixed 512 permitted one-step training pairs in both one and mixed stages. Never fit on a validation prefix, predicted target, canonical state, generator rule or evaluation observation.
solver.failure: Abort and retain the attempted fit on insufficient support, deficient rank, excess condition, nonfinite values or a normalized normal-equation residual above 1e-10. No ridge, fallback driver, random retry or replacement seed.
solver.replay: Save each post-refit full model snapshot and per-action rank/singular values/residual report. Replay every solve from that snapshot's encoder and the regenerated permitted training pairs; compare fitted maps and diagnostics. Verify scheduled refit coverage and unchanged coupling tensors during each solve.
solver.cost: Charge each pair in affine_fit_examples, both encoder passes in auxiliary_observations/model arithmetic, each action system in linear_systems, and all 440 assigned coefficients in fitted_parameter_assignments. Record matrix shapes and solver time separately; SVD arithmetic is not claimed as complete FLOPs.
